lines.meet: My name is Haruto, and I cut runes. You're holding your weapon too tightly, so loosen your grip.
lines.meet_neighbour: We both live near the stones in Silverpine, I believe. I'm Haruto, and I've seen you pass while I copy them.
lines.ask_home: May I ask which town raised you?
lines.ask_work: Which discipline did you practise, before? I'd be interested to hear.
lines.answer_home: Kanazawa, in Japan. My father laid gold leaf there, very thin, very carefully.
lines.answer_work: Calligraphy, thirty-one years. My master corrected me for eleven years before he praised me once.
lines.chat_food: Tea, made properly, with the water just off the boil. Most people here boil it to death and call it tea.
lines.chat_sleep: I rise before dawn, as I always have. The hand is steadiest early, before the day has had a chance to spoil it.
lines.chat_missing: Good paper, and good ink ground slowly on the stone. I've found neither here, and I've looked carefully.
lines.chat_here: The old stones here are fading, so I copy them before they're gone. Somebody must, and I've got the patience for it.
lines.tease_quiet: We could practise silence together, {name}. You're already better at it than my students were.
lines.tease_talker: That was a great many words, {name}. Perhaps one or two could have been left out.
lines.tease_careful: You hesitate before every stroke, {name}. Good, but at some point the brush must touch the paper.
lines.tease_bold: Your strokes are very confident, {name}, and mostly in the wrong place.
lines.tease_any: You'd make a tolerable student, {name}. I mean that as high praise, though it won't sound like it.
lines.tease_back: That was well placed, {name}. I'll allow it.
lines.take_it_kindly: You're correct, {name}, and I accept the correction.
lines.bristle: That isn't a subject for jokes, {name}. Please don't make it one.
lines.apologise: That was careless of me, and I apologise. I should choose my words as I choose my strokes.
lines.double_down: I chose my words carefully, and I won't change them.
lines.needle_quiet: You notice things and say nothing. That's discipline wasted.
lines.needle_talker: Every word you say makes the next one worth less. Please stop for a while.
lines.needle_careful: Hesitating at the last moment ruins more strokes than haste does. Commit, or don't begin.
lines.needle_bold: You're careless, and a rune cut carelessly fails on whoever's standing closest.
lines.needle_any: You call it luck when somebody's spent thirty years on a thing. It isn't luck.
lines.bite_back: I've practised one thing for thirty-one years. Correct your own form before you correct mine.
lines.hurt: I see what you mean. I'll consider it, alone, for a while.
lines.laugh_off: My master was harsher with me every day for eleven years. I found it useful, eventually.
lines.confide: {name}, my right hand has started to shake when I'm tired. Only a little. I'd ask you not to mention it to anyone.
lines.listen: I'll keep it, {name}, carefully, as I keep everything that matters.
lines.look_out: Keep to my left in there, {name}. I can protect what I can see.
lines.accept: Very well, {name}. I'll follow your instruction.
lines.deflect: It's nothing of consequence, {name}. Attend to the others.
lines.check_in: Where is the injury, {name}? Show me exactly.
lines.blame: Somebody was careless in there. Carelessness fails on whoever's standing closest, and that was all of us.
lines.thank: That was a great distance to come back from. Thank you, I won't forget it.
lines.brush_off: It was necessary, so I did it. Breathe slowly now.
lines.worry: That was too close, {name}. Sit, and breathe, and don't hurry.
lines.handed_down: I believe you carried this before me. It'll be kept with care.
lines.hand_fine: Please keep it, I need very little beyond my brushes.
lines.hand_sulk: I'd have offered it, had anyone asked me first.
lines.turn_friendly: Your company is no burden to me, {name}. From me, that's warm.
lines.turn_friends: I'd teach you, {name}, if you asked. I've refused most people who've asked.
lines.turn_grating: We don't suit each other, and saying it plainly is kinder than pretending.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll fight beside you because it's required. Nothing more is required.
lines.make_up: My conduct with you was poor, {name}. I'd like to correct it.
lines.defend: That isn't accurate, and it isn't kind. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: With {name} gone home, the silence is less pleasant than I expected.
lines.friend_back: {name} has returned. Good, I'm glad of it.
lines.common_craft: Thirty-one years at one discipline, studied until the hand no longer needed the mind. A person who works with their hands understands that, I think.
